description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Collins Aerospace is hiring an Engineer I, Software Engineer - Test Engineering to develop and integrate test equipment and solutions for product testing in manufacturing and service environments. The role includes designing prototypes, coordinating design reviews, and creating engineering documentation.
Engineer I Software Test Engineer designing product test solutions, integrating test equipment, and releasing engineering documentation

Responsibilities:
• You will coordinate test equipment design reviews and ensuring the generation of appropriate design documentation
• You will review product designs and create test solutions that maximize test coverage in the manufacturing and service environments
• Design and build prototypes with mechanical and electrical components
• You will be utilizing Software skills in Python, C#, LabView, Visual Basic, and possibly others
• Integrate equipment and lab set-up for testing
• Create and release engineering documentation

Requirements:
• The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued security clearance is required
• U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance
• Active and existing security clearance required after day 1
• Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and less than 2 years prior relevant experience
• Experience with circuit design
• Proven experience with software skills in Python and C# are required

Preferred:
• Experience with testing units and systems in a lab environment
• Experience with design and production phases of product development
• Experience researching specifications for commercial-of-the-shelf (COTS) components and performing component/unit selection trade studies
